verses.text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD|strong="H3068" , all ye lands.
Serve the LORD|strong="H3068" with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
Know ye that the LORD|strong="H3068" he is* God: it is* he that* hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are* his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and* into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and* bless his name.
For the LORD|strong="H3068" is* good; his mercy is* everlasting; and his truth endureth* to all generations.
